user.title: Maintenance
user.description: Track the consumables of your devices (filters, brushes, ink…) and your recurring chores. Nothing to fill in: the consumables are found by themselves, and the tasks are added from the Maintenance panel.

data_description.soon_days: A task (or a consumable at its current pace) due within this many days counts as soon.
data_description.soon_percent: A consumable at or below this percentage counts as soon.
data_description.reminder_time: Once a day, what became overdue or soon is sent, each item once.
data_description.notify_service: For example notify.mobile_app_phone or notify_hub.send; leave empty for no reminder.
data_description.hide_header: The illustrated header above the tabs; the tabs stay, and on a phone the menu button moves beside them.

done.name: Mark as done
done.description: A task done today, or a consumable replaced: the device's reset button is pressed when it has one.

item.name: Item
item.description: A consumable's sensor (sensor.…) or a task (task:…), as shown in the panel.

add_task.name: Add a task
add_task.description: A manual task repeated every N days, weeks or months.

every.name: Every
every.description: How many days, weeks or months between two times.

category.name: Category
category.description: Groups the task in the panel.

remove_task.name: Remove a task
remove_task.description: Deletes a manual task and its reminders.
